objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled artifact that contains company-wide regulations, guidelines, procedures, or instructions subject to versioning, approval workflows, and distribution management.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document describing specific procedures, process sequences, details, and responsible persons to achieve objectives.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document describing detailed work steps, test instructions, and criteria for specific sub-processes.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document, released and published directly without dual control requirements.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning and release process.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for amendments to a document managed without affecting the content or version history of the original document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with defined roles and authorizations in the document management system.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user with permission to create and modify documents and manage change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with write permissions on a document but no relevance in the release workflow signature.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for approving a document and determining its distribution to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user with permission to view approved documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user authorized to translate released content into another language.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group with read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group permitted to create reactivation requests for invalidated documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific permissions and roles for document access and distribution.

objs.name: version
objs.description: A release state of a document with associated metadata, signatures, and validity period.

objs.name: release_request
objs.description: A workflow task initiating the approval process for a document through creator, reviewer, and releaser steps.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and extend the validity period of a document approaching expiration.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and reactivate a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic confirmation by a workflow participant documenting their approval or review of a document version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A collection of user groups and persons designated to receive document releases via email or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital confirmation of approval recorded in the system for document release workflow steps.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A system record documenting all actions, changes, and approvals related to a document.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined format for a document type with integrated tags for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A workflow-supported confirmation by a recipient of document delivery and understanding.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Standardized properties and attributes associated with documents such as references, IT applications, and scope.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a released document in a language other than the original.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A system instance in a multi-client environment for which document visibility can be configured.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A business division or department that can be referenced in document properties.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A business risk that can be referenced and linked to documents in the system.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system that can be referenced in document properties for traceability.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification category for documents such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

objs.name: document_abbreviation
objs.description: A fixed prefix code assigned to each document type for naming purposes.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or custom properties of a document maintained through property editing.

objs.name: pdf_conversion
objs.description: An automatic system-supported conversion of a document to PDF format upon saving.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific display presenting documents and workflow tasks relevant to the user.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate creation of a new document in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the textual or structural content of a document using an integrated editing client.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Update standardized or custom properties and attributes of a document through property editing.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read or write permissions to users and user groups for a document.

evts.name: assign_release_participant
evts.description: Designate specific users as author, reviewer, or releaser for a document's approval workflow.

evts.name: upload_external_document
evts.description: Attach an external file or document to a document object in the system.

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start the three-step approval workflow consisting of creator signature, review, and release steps.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically confirm and approve a document during a workflow step by an authorized participant.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Examine document content for technical and formal compliance as a reviewer.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document for distribution to readers by a designated releaser.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to authorized readers in the system.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document attachment to a main document subject to the same release process.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Add a non-controlled document attachment to a document released directly without approval workflow.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived, effective after the next release of the main document.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Generate a new version of a released document in editing status due to content or property changes.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a proposed amendment to a document without modifying the original or its version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Accept and integrate a change proposal into a new version of the document.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request to check and extend the validity period of a document approaching expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm ongoing validity of a document and update its expiration date.

evts.name: request_override
evts.description: Create a request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid and revoke user authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: request_reactivation
evts.description: Initiate a request to re-validate and reactivate a previously invalidated archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore an archived document to active status with a new version and maintained properties.

evts.name: create_distribution_list
evts.description: Define user groups and persons to receive document releases via email or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Automatically notify assigned users and user groups of a new document version release via email.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Initiate a workflow task requiring recipients to actively confirm document delivery and understanding.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Submit active confirmation that a document has been received and understood by a recipient.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document in an alternative language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check a translated document version for accuracy and appropriateness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated document version for visibility in the corresponding language.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF format for web display and distribution.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Produce a role-specific evaluation report filtering documents by selected parameters and criteria.

evts.name: configure_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify which system clients can access a document in a multi-client environment.
